Legal.hosting:
Website: Vercel Inc., 440 N Barranca Ave #4133, Covina, CA 91723, USA.
Guide data and photos: Supabase, servers located in Europe.
Legal.privacy: This guide requires no account and collects no personal data. There is no advertising, no tracking cookie and no audience measurement.
Legal.storage:
A cookie remembers your language. Your phone also keeps the guide's pages, so you can read them without signal, and your display choices.
Your location is only used if you allow it, to show you on the map: it is neither sent nor stored.
Legal.thirdParties: The base map comes from OpenStreetMap: your browser requests the images of the area shown, which sends it your IP address. Links to Google Maps, Apple Maps, Waze or the places' websites open services with their own rules.
Legal.rights: For any question about this information or your data: {email}. You can also contact the French data protection authority, the CNIL (cnil.fr).
Legal.credits: Openly licensed photos are credited on each place's page. The base map is © OpenStreetMap contributors.
